verdict.rationale: Google Voice's subscription comparison lists AI-powered note-taking ('yapay zeka destekli not alma') as a feature of a higher tier, and automatic call recording on the top tier. That is a direct but single, thin mention of AI call handling. Voicemail-to-text transcription is documented, but it covers voicemail rather than live calls, so it does not count toward this story. missing for 10: explicit call summaries, full call transcripts, evidence they are attached to the call/conversation thread, in-depth first-party docs on the AI note-taking feature, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, calls get AI summaries and transcripts attached to the conversation
